Meet the photographer

Hi, I'm Vikki Shing.

I started Tejal Visuals in Chhani in 2022 with one idea: when you look back at your photos, you should feel the day again, not just see it.

Four years on, I still shoot the same way. Natural light, candid moments, the laugh that happens just before the pose. Weddings, pre-wedding shoots, baby showers, portraits: every booking gets my full attention.

We're local, right here near Gurudwara Road, so just WhatsApp me your date and we'll talk it through at your pace.

  • Natural, candid and emotional storytelling
  • Photo and video from one team
  • Cinematic editing done in-house
  • Local to Chhani, Vadodara
  • Open all days, simple WhatsApp booking

How it works

What it's like to book with us

No confusing forms. You message us on WhatsApp, we take it from there.

01

Say hello on WhatsApp

Send your name, event type, date, location and the services you need. One tap on any button here pre-fills it for you.

02

We plan and quote

03

We shoot, then we craft

We stay natural and candid on the day, then edit your photos and cinematic film with the same care.
